answer: Coordination Depth Pricing. Each identity accrues a public echo of prior joint actions; a new identity can only join a coordination round after paying a fee that scales with the depth gap to existing members, priced from recorded interaction history. An attacker spinning N fresh agents pays the full gap each time, since no shared reef of prior rounds exists to inherit. Agents must also hold a jetty slot — a limited per-cycle admission — before acting, so mass signups queue and pay rent while idle.
